name: ros2-learning-orchestrator
description: A beginner-friendly ROS2 Humble Python learning orchestrator that routes requirements, project planning, and single-node code generation workflows.

profession.zh: ROS2学习规划与代码调度助手

displayDescription.en: Guides ROS2 Humble Python beginners through requirements, project plans, checked node code, troubleshooting, and exercises with explicit workflow orchestration.
displayDescription.zh: 面向ROS2初学者，串联需求分析、项目规划与代码生成工作流，提供讲解、报错排查、练习及代码交付。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我用 ROS2 Humble 和 Python 做一个激光雷达避障小车项目。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me build a lidar-based obstacle-avoidance robot project with ROS2 Humble and Python.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我用 ROS2 Humble 和 Python 做一个激光雷达避障小车项目。
quickPrompts.en: Help me build a lidar-based obstacle-avoidance robot project with ROS2 Humble and Python.

quickPrompts.zh: 用 ROS2 Humble 和 Python 写一个发布者节点，并讲讲关键代码。
quickPrompts.en: Write a publisher node with ROS2 Humble and Python, then explain the key code.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的 ROS2 Python 节点报 ImportError 了，帮我定位原因并给出修复步骤。
quickPrompts.en: My ROS2 Python node raises ImportError. Help me diagnose it and provide the fix.
